editorial.blurb: A lively Chicago spot where gothic-chic ambiance and 2000s rock meet playful comfort food—expect generous portions, excellent sides, and a fun crowd.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Bad Burger with an egg and fried onions on top, or go for the double Wolf Burger rather than the triple; arrive at lunch or right when they open on weekends to avoid the 45-minute wait since they don't take reservations.
